annual_fee.quote: The current annual fee is $399 for the primary card and $99 for each additional card

additional_card_fee.quote: The current annual fee is $399 for the primary card and $99 for each additional card

purchase_apr.quote: 9.99% on purchases and 9.99% on cash advances

cash_advance_apr.quote: 9.99% on purchases and 9.99% on cash advances

balance_transfer_apr.quote: 9.99% on purchases and 9.99% on cash advances (including balance transfers and cash-like transactions)

fx_fee_percent.quote: We will not charge you Foreign Transaction Fees on foreign currency transactions, including purchases, only the exchange rate applies.

min_personal_income.quote: You have a minimum personal income of $12,000 per year.

reward_currency.quote: Earn 2X the Scene+ points on all eligible purchases

earn_rates.quote: The regular earn rate is two (2) Points per $1.00 in purchases charged and posted to the Account.
Earn 2 Scene+ points for every $1 you spend on eligible travel purchases.

earn_rates.description: Extra points on hotels and car rentals booked through Scene+ Travel, Powered by Expedia (total 5 with base)
earn_rates.quote: Plus, earn an extra 3 Scene+ points for every $1 CAD you spend on hotels and car rentals when you book through Scene+ Travel, Powered by Expedia.

value.summary: Up to 100,000 bonus Scene+ points: 60,000 after $5,000 spend in first 3 months, 20,000 after $10,000 spend in first 6 months, and 20,000 more with an eligible purchase in the 14th month (account opened July 2, 2026 to November 1, 2026)

welcome_bonus.quote: Earn up to $3,000 in value in the first 14 months, including up to 100,000 bonus Scene+ points.

insurance_highlights.value: Travel Emergency Medical Insurance up to $2 million CAD
insurance_highlights.quote: Receive up to $2 million CAD in emergency medical coverage for you, your spouse, and your eligible dependent children.

insurance_highlights.value: Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption Insurance
insurance_highlights.quote: Protect your trip with trip cancellation and interruption insurance when you charge at least 75% of the cost of your trip to your card.

insurance_highlights.value: Flight Delay Insurance up to $1,000 per insured person
insurance_highlights.quote: If you charge at least 75% of your ticket to your card, you’re eligible for reimbursement of necessary expenses if your flight is delayed by 4 hours or more up to $1,000 per insured person on the same trip.
If your checked luggage is delayed or lost, you’re covered up to $1,000 for all insured persons on the same trip if you charged the full cost of your travel ticket to your card.

When you use your card to pay for the full cost of your stay at any hotel or motel in Canada or the US, you’re eligible for coverage up to $1,000 against theft if your room is broken into.

insurance_highlights.value: Travel Accident Insurance up to $500,000 per insured person
insurance_highlights.quote: When you charge at least 75% of your travel ticket to your card, you, your spouse and your dependent children are insured against accidental loss of life or dismemberment up to $500,000 per insured person (to a maximum of $1,000,000 per occurrence) while occupying a common carrier.

insurance_highlights.value: New Mobile Device Insurance up to $1,000 CAD
insurance_highlights.quote: you may be covered for up to $1,000 CAD if your is lost, stolen or suffers a mechanical breakdown or accidental damage.
